shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git status --short && sed -n '1,260p' src/types/messages.ts && sed -n '1,200p' src/index.ts && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by|IncomingMessage|OutgoingMessage\" src --glob '*test*' | head -160"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"@spec|specs/.*#[0-9]+|validated by\" src scripts specs | head -120 && cat package.json && sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md 2>/dev/null || true && rg -n \"SessionSummaryFrame|list_sessions|session_list\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!ticket.md'"'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,140p' src/infrastructure/stores/sessionStoreListSignature.test.ts && sed -n '1,160p' src/types/sessionStore.ts && sed -n '1,120p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n \"@spec|spec:\" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs src | head -80 && git log -5 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+#[0-9]+\" src scripts --glob '*test.ts' || true; rg -n \"test descriptor|descriptor.*spec|spec anchor|#ordinal\" AGENTS.md .lore specs scripts || true; rg -n \"messages\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | head -30; git status --branch --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts | sed -n '18,60p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md && node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs && timeout 300 env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules npx jest --runTestsByPath src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts --runInBand'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/types/messages.ts src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/index.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/types/messages.ts && git commit -m "feat(protocol): validate conversation list frames" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --branch --short'
